verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a full REST API (with a live OpenAPI spec), a CLI, and a Python SDK covering the entire instance lifecycle (search, rent, boot, connect, copy data, teardown), plus a dedicated 'agent skill' explicitly built for AI coding assistants to create instances, deploy endpoints, manage keys and check balances without human console interaction, and scoped API keys for CI/CD automation. No MCP server is documented, but the story only requires API/CLI/MCP and API+CLI+agent-skill coverage is thorough and probe-verified (OpenAPI live). Missing for 10: no MCP server evidence, no independent hands-on confirmation that an agent successfully completed a full unattended lifecycle end-to-end.
